theme: A partner molecule that fixes solubility
title: Cocrystal Coformer Selection: Solubility Under a Stability Floor
strategies: reference-only: always pick the given weak-bonding reference coformer (reproduces the checker baseline -> ~0.1)

bond-strength maximization: scan the regulatory-approved list and pick the coformer/ratio with the strongest hydrogen-bond synthon match that still clears the stability floor -- forms a very stable cocrystal, but the huge lattice-energy excess crushes solubility on the planted bond-monster cases

interior-optimum search: brute-force every regulatory-approved (coformer, ratio) pair, compute the exact solubility-improvement formula (polarity bonus minus lattice-energy-excess penalty) for each, and keep the true maximizer -- lands on a coformer that clears the stability floor with a small excess and high polarity
same idea generalized: any search that actually evaluates the given trade-off formula instead of proxy-maximizing bond strength converges to the interior optimum
innovation_hook: Selecting the coformer with the strongest hydrogen bond to the API maximizes cocrystal stability and often lowers solubility below the original, defeating the purpose. The insight is targeting an intermediate lattice energy: stable enough to form, weak enough to dissolve.
